story_description: As a user configuring hooks in the visual builder, I need a description field for each hook entry so that I can distinguish between multiple hooks of the same event type and understand what each hook does at a glance.
task: E005-F004-S001-T006: Implement Hook Description Field UI Components
task_description: Build the UI components that display and edit hook description fields in the hooks table and canvas views, including validation and persistence to settings.json.
atom: E005-F004-S001-T006-A001: Hook Description Field UI Implementation
atom_description: Implement the complete UI for hook description fields including the table column display, inline editing capability, canvas node labeling, and schema validation for the required description field in hook entries.
problem_statement: Current hooks UI shows repetitive event type names like PostToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUse with no way for users to distinguish between different hooks that handle the same event type. Users cannot understand what each hook does without examining the underlying command, making hook management error-prone and confusing.
scope_in: Add description property to HookEntry model with required validation
Display description column in hooks table view between Event and Scope columns
Implement inline text editing for description field in table rows
Show description as label on hook nodes in canvas view
Validate description field is non-empty when saving hooks
Update JSON serialization to include description field
Display description in hook detail panel when node selected
Truncate long descriptions with ellipsis in table and show full text on hover
scope_out: Bulk editing of multiple hook descriptions
assumptions: HookEntry model already exists and can be extended with new properties
The hooks table view supports adding new columns
Canvas view HookNode can display text labels
Settings.json schema can be extended with optional fields that become required
Inline editing patterns exist elsewhere in the app that can be reused
constraints: Description field must be required for new hooks but optional for existing hooks during migration
Table column width must accommodate descriptions up to 60 characters without truncation
Canvas node labels must fit within node bounds or truncate gracefully
JSON schema changes must maintain backward compatibility with existing settings files
Description must be plain text only with no special characters that break JSON
functional_requirements: FR1: HookEntry model includes description: String property marked as required
FR2: Hooks table displays Description column between Event and Scope columns
FR3: Table cells show description text truncated to 50 characters with ellipsis if longer
FR4: Hovering over truncated description shows full text in tooltip
FR5: Double-clicking description cell enables inline text editing
FR6: Pressing Enter commits description edit, Escape cancels edit
FR7: Canvas hook nodes display description as primary label below event type
FR8: Empty description validation error prevents saving with message Please provide a description
FR9: JSON export includes description field in hook entry objects
FR10: JSON import parses description field and displays in UI
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR1: Inline editing must respond within 16ms to keystroke input
NFR2: Table must handle 100 hooks with descriptions without scroll lag
NFR3: Description field validation must complete within 5ms
NFR4: Tooltip appearance delay is 500ms matching system defaults
implementation_steps: Step 1: Add description property to HookEntry struct in Blaze/Sources/Settings/Hooks/Models/HookEntry.swift with default empty string for migration
Step 2: Update HookEntry Codable conformance to encode and decode description field
Step 3: Create DescriptionTableColumn view component in Blaze/Sources/Settings/Hooks/Views/DescriptionTableColumn.swift
Step 4: Add DescriptionTableColumn to HooksTableView columns array after Event column
Step 5: Implement InlineTextEditor view for description editing in Blaze/Sources/Settings/Hooks/Views/InlineTextEditor.swift
Step 6: Wire InlineTextEditor to HookEntry binding for two-way data flow
Step 7: Add description label to HookNode view below event type badge in canvas
Step 8: Implement truncation helper function that cuts at 50 chars and appends ellipsis character
Step 9: Add tooltip modifier to truncated description cells showing full text
Step 10: Add validation rule in HooksBuilderViewModel requiring non-empty description
Step 11: Display validation error banner when description is empty on save attempt
Step 12: Update HooksInstallationService JSON export to include description field
Step 13: Update HooksImportService JSON import to parse description field
Step 14: Add unit tests for HookEntry description serialization
Step 15: Add UI tests for description editing workflow
commands_used: xcrun simctl spawn booted Blaze.app for UI testing
data_model_changes: HookEntry struct gains description: String property with default value of empty string for backward compatibility
Existing hooks without description field decode to empty string then require user to add description before next save
api_contracts: HookEntry.description: String - required property representing human-readable hook purpose
HooksBuilderViewModel.validateHook(_:) -> [ValidationError] - returns error if description is empty
InlineTextEditor.onCommit: (String) -> Void - callback when user confirms edit
InlineTextEditor.onCancel: () -> Void - callback when user cancels edit
event_contracts: HookEntryDidUpdate notification posted when description field changes
ValidationErrorsDidChange notification posted when description validation state changes
ui_states: Default: Description column shows text in normal weight system font
Editing: Description cell shows text field with blue border and cursor
Truncated: Description shows first 50 characters followed by ellipsis character
Hover: Full description appears in system tooltip after 500ms delay
Error: Description cell shows red border when validation fails
Empty: Description cell shows placeholder text Add description in gray italic
ui_interactions: Single click on description cell selects the row
Double click on description cell enters inline edit mode
Press Enter in edit mode commits the change and exits edit mode
Press Escape in edit mode reverts change and exits edit mode
Click outside cell while editing commits the change
Tab from description field moves to next editable field in row
ui_copy: Validation error message: Please provide a description for this hook
Tooltip prefix: Hook description followed by full text
Canvas node label format: Description text on single line below event badge
edge_cases: EC1: Description containing only whitespace characters treated as empty and fails validation
EC2: Description with exactly 50 characters displays without truncation or ellipsis
EC3: Description with 51 characters truncates to 50 plus ellipsis making 51 visible characters
EC4: Pasting very long text into description field accepts only first 200 characters
EC5: Description with newline characters displays newlines as spaces in table view
EC6: Description with special JSON characters like quotes and backslashes escapes correctly on export
EC7: Importing hook with missing description field sets empty string and marks as requiring edit
EC8: Multiple hooks can have identical descriptions without warning
EC9: Undo operation after description edit reverts to previous description value
EC10: Description edit in progress when app quits prompts save or discard
failure_modes: FM1: JSON decode fails if description field contains invalid UTF-8 - fallback to empty string with warning
FM2: Table scroll performance degrades with very long descriptions - mitigated by truncation
FM3: Tooltip fails to appear due to accessibility settings - description still visible in detail panel
FM4: Inline editor loses focus unexpectedly - auto-commits current value to prevent data loss
rollback_plan: Remove description property from HookEntry struct and revert to previous UI without description column. Existing settings.json files with description field will have it ignored on import. No data migration needed since description is additive only.

open_questions: Should description have a maximum character limit enforced in UI
Should we warn users about duplicate descriptions across hooks
Should description be searchable in a future hooks filter feature
notes: This atom focuses on the UI layer only. The schema changes to settings.json are documented here but the actual schema validation enforcement is a separate concern. Consider adding description suggestions based on event type and matcher patterns in a future enhancement.
verification_steps: Run xcodebuild -scheme Blaze -destination platform=macOS test and verify all HookEntry description tests pass
Launch app, navigate to Settings then Hooks, create new hook, verify description field is visible and required
Export hooks to JSON file and verify description field is present in output
Import JSON with descriptions and verify they display correctly in table and canvas

risks: Adding required field may break existing hook configurations that lack description
Inline editing may conflict with table row selection behavior
Very long descriptions could break table layout
mitigations: Description field defaults to empty string on import for backward compatibility
Implement edit mode state machine that handles selection and editing separately
Truncation at 50 characters with tooltip prevents layout issues
risk_register.blast_radius: Limited to hooks settings UI. No impact on hook execution, engine integration, or other settings panels.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If inline editing proves problematic, fall back to edit button that opens modal dialog for description entry.
